Find a Graduate Program
Master's and doctoral degrees and certificates
We are one of Canada's top medical/doctoral universities with a broad combination of human, animal, and plant studies all in one campus. As one of Canada's 15 leading research-intensive universities, USask provides a highly collaborative research environment with some of the best facilities and analytical tools in the country.
If you are looking for undergraduate level programs, please consult our undergraduate students' website.
